name: vlm_shape_benchmark_2d
description: VLM Shape Benchmark 2D evaluates vision–language models on 2D shape recognition and spatial-relation reasoning. It presents natural-language queries about shapes, counts, orientations, and relative positions in synthetic or real images. The benchmark measures how well models ground linguistic descriptions to visual shape attributes and spatial configurations.
reputation: A niche benchmark used primarily in VLM spatial-reasoning evaluations; modest adoption relative to larger VQA datasets.
